qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the brake coupling D/G center bolt on the gear box housing?
What torque should be applied to both outer screws on the brake coupling D/G?
What screw size is used for the brake coupling D/G on gear box housing?
Which transmission types does this brake coupling specification apply to?
What is the highest torque value specified for the brake coupling assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: 63 Nm is the highest torque value specified.

qa_pairs.question: How many different torque values are specified for the brake coupling screws?
qa_pairs.answer: Three different torque values: 15 Nm, 30 Nm, and 63 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What is the procedure for inserting screws on the brake coupling?
qa_pairs.answer: Insert all screws until contact is made with screw head in each case center bolt.

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection number covers this planetary gear drive information?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 24-7 Automatic Transmission, subsection 24 22 Planetary gear drive.

qa_pairs.question: What is the reference code for this brake coupling specification?
Are there multiple entries with the same torque specification for outer screws?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, there are multiple entries showing both outer screws with 30 Nm and 63 Nm specifications.
